timeline.title: Where it all started
timeline.description: Drawn to sunny Southern California, Alexis and Kelsey both found themselves at UCLA, where they met at a midsummer pool party in 2017. They instantly hit it off, but two weeks later, Kelsey left for a five-month abroad program in South Africa. When she returned, they made things official and have been inseparable since.

timeline.title: First apartment together
timeline.description: After navigating years of UCLA grad school and separate apartments, Kelsey officially moved in with Alexis... and his two roommates. It easily could have been a total circus, but it became one of their favorite chapters. Kelsey remembers how thoughtful Alexis was in making space for her and Alexis loved how Kelsey brought warmth through her decorations and singing, not to mention Hazel (her cat, who they now proudly co-parent).

timeline.title: Bay Area chapter begins
timeline.description: After a sudden plot-twist move up north to Palo Alto, they stayed closely connected to their LA circle while also building new roots in the Bay Area. Alexis and Kelsey are each pursuing their calling in clean energy—Alexis at Tesla and Kelsey at Stanford—both driven by a shared hope of making a positive impact on the world.

timeline.title: Surfing, scuba diving, saying yes
timeline.description: Surrounded by some of their favorite people after a week in Costa Rica, Alexis asked Kelsey to marry him on the beach under an unforgettable sunset. They can’t wait to celebrate with their friends and family, and to keep building a life full of music, dancing, cooking elaborate meals, and finding humor in just about anything.
